  "memo":"Recommend clear. R04 holds because this is a first attempt on a newly opened account with an amount above the category reference. It is Context only; no other rule holds and no adverse family is present. Household exceptions are unnecessary, and no earlier outcome settles the order. No completed check changes that assessment. Ordinary new-customer onboarding is more plausible than demonstrable never-pay intent; no installment was due. Under FP-2 §6.6(c), clear is the only permitted disposition. No verification check is needed."
